test_title: PYST 17: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to

be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion/s logically follow/s from the given

statements.
solution:
**Statements:**

Some telephones are curtains.

All curtains are lamps.

No lamps is books.

The least possible Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7c3ba092ce3d1212ab41aefc3db81bae44adc0bc37a928aa7d0c7d5872bf9d4.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) All lamps are telephones. - **False **(because Some telephones are curtains and All curtains are lamps. So, All lamps are telephones it is not possible)

(II) No books is lamps. - **True **(because No lamps is books given. So, No books is lamps it is true)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion (II) is follow".**
